'''Earl''' was a title of [[Noble/Legends|nobility]]. Prior to the [[Force Wars]], several of the feudal gangsters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Shikaakwa]] wore the title of earl. [[Time/Legends|Millennia]] later, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Veruna]] of the world of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was related to an [[Earl of Vis/Legends|earl]] of [[Vis/Legends|Vis]].
